scenes.narration: We separate two kinds of breadth: the breadth of knowledge a scientist draws on, and the breadth of research topics that scientist pursues.
scenes.visual_intent: Animate two orthogonal dimensions labeled Knowledge Base and Research Topics.

scenes.narration: The study follows 7.13 million scholars, 61.16 million author-year observations, and 19 disciplines from 1900 to 2021.

scenes.narration: Topic breadth shows the opposite pattern: it is associated with greater disruption, but lower integrative novelty.
scenes.visual_intent: Mirror the prior scene with Research-topic breadth up; disruption up; integrative novelty down.

scenes.narration: The takeaway is that scientific breadth is not a single strategy. Where scholars search for knowledge and how widely they move across topics can shape different forms of novelty.
